deliverables.problem: GitHub Actions CI matrix failing across Node 20 / Python 3.12
deliverables.root_cause_explanation:
# Root Cause Diagnosis - Asyncio Worker Teardown

## Root Cause

Python 3.12 enforces stricter event loop finalization. When background workers terminated, un-cancelled pending tasks threw `RuntimeError: Event loop is closed`.

## Solution

Applied graceful task cancellation and awaited remaining task cancellation before loop finalization.

deliverables.problem: 12 flaky tests in FastAPI backend failing under pytest-xdist
deliverables.root_cause_explanation:
# Root Cause Diagnosis - Pytest Parallel Worker Mock Contamination

## Root Cause

`auth_service` fixture was defined with `scope='session'`, causing shared mock state to leak across parallel worker processes under `pytest-xdist`.

## Solution

Refactored fixture scope to `function`, ensuring strict per-test instance isolation.

deliverables.problem: Tink Streaming AEAD buffer wrap under zero-length tag parameter
deliverables.root_cause_explanation:
# Root Cause Diagnosis - Tink Streaming AEAD Buffer Boundary Check

## Root Cause

Streaming AEAD decryptor did not enforce minimum tag size constraint before buffer chunk allocation.

## Solution

Added strict lower-bound check (`len(tag) >= 16`) preventing invalid decryption execution.
